Package org.cibseven.bpm.impl.juel

Class JuelBeanELResolver

java.lang.Object
jakarta.el.ELResolver
jakarta.el.BeanELResolver
org.cibseven.bpm.impl.juel.JuelBeanELResolver
public class JuelBeanELResolver extends jakarta.el.BeanELResolver
A BeanELResolver that selects and invokes bean methods itself, with the rules of the upstream Jakarta Expression Language API, instead of leaving this to the EL API of the runtime.

CIB seven 2.2 shipped a relocated copy of the upstream jakarta.el-api 4.0.0 inside cibseven-juel, so method calls in expressions behaved the same on every runtime. Since 3.0, the jakarta.el classes come from the runtime. Tomcat's EL API selects methods with its own algorithm: it rejects some overloaded and varargs calls as ambiguous, and it wraps an array passed to a varargs parameter into a new array (CIB7-2609). This resolver restores the 2.2 behaviour on every runtime.

The method selection and the parameter building are taken from jakarta.el.ELUtil and jakarta.el.BeanELResolver#invoke of jakarta.el:jakarta.el-api 6.0.1 (Apache License 2.0). Version 4.0.0, which CIB seven 2.2 used, has the same rules. As in 2.2:

  • whether a method is eligible, i.e. whether an argument can be coerced to a parameter type, is checked with JUEL's ExpressionFactory: the one in the context if it is JUEL's, otherwise a default one. Resolvers that implement convertToType do not take part, and the global ELManager factory of the runtime, e.g. Tomcat EL or Expressly, is not used;
  • the arguments of the selected method are converted with ELContext.convertToType(Object, Class), so resolvers come first, then JUEL.
Intentional differences from 2.2, where 2.2 failed:
  • null as the only argument of a varargs parameter becomes an array with the converted null, e.g. [""] for String... and [0] for Long...; 2.2 threw a NullPointerException;
  • a call without a parameter array (params == null) is a call without arguments; 2.2 threw a NullPointerException;
  • a method that cannot be accessed throws a MethodNotFoundException; 2.2 threw a NullPointerException.
Properties are still resolved by the BeanELResolver of the runtime.

    • getCoercionFactory

      protected static jakarta.el.ExpressionFactory getCoercionFactory(jakarta.el.ELContext context)
      The factory that decides whether an argument can be coerced to a parameter type: JUEL's factory in the context, otherwise a default JUEL factory. In CIB seven 2.2, the relocated ELUtil asked its global factory, which was JUEL's. The global ELManager factory of the runtime is never used.
